links.outcome: Calibration (ECE) and discrimination (AUROC) of LLM confidence with verification and multi-agent fusion versus single-specialist baseline
links.effect: On MedQA-250, ECE 0.091 (74.4% reduction vs baseline), AUROC 0.630 (+0.056) at 59.2% accuracy; calibration gains of 49-74% across four settings; Two-Phase Verification drove ECE reduction.
links.quote: On MedQA-250, the full system achieves ECE = 0.091 (74.4% reduction over the single-specialist baseline) and AUROC = 0.630 (+0.056) at 59.2% accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent specialist ensemble with S-score weighted fusion to select answers and calibrate confidence

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel multi-agent architecture with consistency verification and weighted fusion to improve uncertainty calibration on medical QA benchmarks. Because this is a newly developed model/agent architecture rather than an organizational deployment practice/guardrail tested on an existing tool, tests_practice is false.
